userStories.title: Generalized per-GPU pair-sweep tmux launcher
userStories.description: Create scripts/start_long_pair_sweep_tmux.sh, an executable bash script that launches one independent same-env training run per GPU in a single tmux session. Usage: scripts/start_long_pair_sweep_tmux.sh <session_name> <run_suffix> <gpu_csv> <task1:config1> [<task2:config2> ...]. The gpu_csv is a comma-separated list of GPU indices (e.g., '0,1,2,3'). Each task:config pair is mapped to one GPU in order. The number of GPUs must equal the number of pairs; otherwise exit with error. For each pair, create a tmux window named gpu<idx> that invokes scripts/run_same_env_config_one_task.sh with arguments TASK GPU CONFIG_PATH EPOCHS ENV_ID RUN_NAME EVAL_EPISODES SEED. Default EPOCHS env is 100, default EVAL_EPISODES env is 20, default SEED env is 0, default ENV_ID env is 0. The RUN_NAME passed to the inner script must be ${task_basename}_${run_suffix}_e${EPOCHS}_s${SEED}, where task_basename is the task name with no slashes. Tee the inner script's output to ${ELSA_ARTIFACT_ROOT:-/mnt/raid0/siwon/ELSA-Robotics-Challenge-artifacts}/logs/long_pair_sweep/${run_suffix}/gpu${gpu}_${task}.log. Use set -euo pipefail. Verify each config file exists before launching; abort with error if missing. Kill any prior tmux session with the same name before creating new. Print a final summary line listing session_name and log dir. chmod +x the script.

userStories.title: Same-env sweep results aggregator script
userStories.description: Create scripts/aggregate_sameenv_sweep_results.py, a Python script that scans the same-env results tree and emits a CSV summary. Usage: python scripts/aggregate_sameenv_sweep_results.py [--result-root ROOT] [--tasks TASK1 TASK2 ...] [--out OUT_PATH] [--dry-run]. Default --result-root is ${ELSA_ARTIFACT_ROOT:-/mnt/raid0/siwon/ELSA-Robotics-Challenge-artifacts}/results/same_env_suite. Default --tasks is close_box slide_block_to_target insert_onto_square_peg scoop_with_spatula. Default --out is results/sameenv_sweep_summary.csv. The script must (1) iterate over each task subdir under result-root, (2) for each run-name subdir, glob env_*/result.json, (3) for each result.json found, parse its sibling resolved_config.yaml (one directory up at run_dir/resolved_config.yaml) using PyYAML to extract action_pipeline_preset, vision_backbone, separate_gripper_head, policy_head_type, dino_lora_rank, action_chunk_len (default 1 if missing), receding_horizon_execute_steps (default 1 if missing), joint_velocity_servo_gain (empty if missing), joint_velocity_servo_clip (empty if missing); (4) extract sr or success_rate or mean_per_env_sr from result.json (try keys in this order, fall back to None); (5) extract rmse from offline_seen_env.rmse if present, otherwise None; (6) write a CSV with columns task, run_name, env_dir, action_pipeline, vision_backbone, separate_gripper_head, policy_head_type, dino_lora_rank, action_chunk_len, receding_horizon_execute_steps, joint_velocity_servo_gain, joint_velocity_servo_clip, sr, rmse, result_path. With --dry-run, print the same rows to stdout as a TSV without writing to disk. The script must support 'python scripts/aggregate_sameenv_sweep_results.py --help' and exit 0 with --help. Use argparse. Use only standard library plus PyYAML.
